test_name: Validate Successful Login with Correct Credentials
description: This scenario tests the ability of a user to successfully log in using valid email and password credentials. The test ensures that proper authentication occurs and navigates to the dashboard post-login.
steps: 2. Verify the visibility of the email and password input fields.
3. Verify the visibility of the 'Log In' button and ensure it is enabled.
4. Enter a valid email into the email input field.
5. Enter a valid password into the password input field.
7. Wait for the page to navigate to https://dev.roost.ai.
8. Verify that the navigation was successful by asserting the URL is https://dev.roost.ai.
9. Verify that the dashboard elements are visible, including the user's dashboard header.
10. Verify that user-specific information, such as name or email, is displayed on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is successfully navigated to the dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
The dashboard displays user-specific information, such as email or name.
No error messages are displayed on the dashboard.
edge_cases: Attempt login with an invalid password.
Attempt login with an invalid email format.
Attempt login with both email and password fields empty.
Attempt login while the server is down.
Verify that the session token is created and stored correctly in the browser's cookies or local storage.
dependencies: A valid user account must exist in the system.
The email used in the test must be verified in the system.
The system must be online and reachable at the time of testing.
performance_metrics: Time taken for the login request to complete.
Time taken to render the dashboard after login.
accessibility_requirements: Verify that the login form fields have aria-label attributes for assistive technologies.
Verify that the 'Log In' button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
